request.acceptance_criteria: [1] Each live run in the bare overview prints dashboardHeadline's progress/verdict and phase/needs-you lines under its unchanged first line. [2] `go test -short -timeout 20m -run 'TestTheBareOverview' ./internal/cli/` passes, including the overview-equals-watch headline test. [3] `make gate` passes.
request.description:
Epic hn6, wave 4, deliverable (c): the bare `ticfac` overview (internal/cli/overview.go, tick 2qz) adopts the dashboard's per-run headline. A person glancing at the listing then sees the same progress, health verdict and needs-you that `ticfac watch` shows for that run. The words come from the same function, so the two cannot disagree.

Today, renderOverview prints one line per run: "<run-id>: <state word> — <reason> — clear with: <cmd>". Each overviewRun already carries the run's full statusmodel.Model when it was gathered (see overviewEntryOf and fullEntry). The watch renderer (internal/cli/watch_view.go) provides `dashboardHeadline(m statusmodel.Model, st watchStyles, width int) []string`. Its three lines are: (1) epic id + title + host · liveness; (2) progress bar n/m ticks · elapsed · ETA · health verdict; (3) the phase bar + needs-you.

Change:
- For every NON-history run whose model was gathered: keep the existing first line exactly as it is (scripts and tests grep it). Under it, print dashboardHeadline's lines 2 and 3, indented two spaces, with identity styles when stdout is not a TTY and ANSI styles when it is (reuse watchTerminalSize / the TTY check in watch.go; do not edit watch.go). Use the terminal width, or 100 when unknown.
- History runs (`--all`) and runs whose model could not be gathered (the cheap entries) print exactly as today.
- `ticfac --json` is unchanged: it already emits the model.

Files: internal/cli/overview.go, internal/cli/overview_test.go and internal/cli/overview_history_test.go (only where an exact-output assertion needs the new lines). Do not edit watch_view.go, watch.go, internal/statusmodel or cloudflare/.

Tests:
- TestTheBareOverviewShowsTheDashboardHeadline: a local run fixture with 5/6 ticks closed and a healthy verdict prints "5/6 ticks" and "healthy" under its run line. A held run prints its needs-you command in the headline AND keeps the "clear with:" suffix on the first line.
- TestTheBareOverviewHeadlineMatchesWatch: for the same model, the overview's headline lines equal dashboardHeadline(m, identity styles, 100)[1:3] with two spaces of indent. This is the one-model-two-renderers guarantee.
- History runs still print one line each.
- Existing: `go test -short -timeout 20m -run 'TestTheBareOverview' ./internal/cli/` passes.

Run: `go test -short -timeout 20m -run 'TestTheBareOverview' ./internal/cli/`. Must still pass: `go test -short -timeout 20m ./internal/cli/`, and then `make gate`.
request.title: Bare ticfac overview shows the dashboard headline
